hypotheses.explanation: Payment Charge returned UNAVAILABLE with connection refused, causing checkout HTTP 500. Paymentservice subsequently logged server startup and a successful health check, supporting temporary service unavailability.

An unavailable payment endpoint on the checkout-to-payment connection could explain the refused TCP connection and failed charge; endpoint-level versus service-wide failure cannot be conclusively distinguished.
Two Convert calls took approximately 79 ms client-side but less than 1 ms server-side, suggesting transport-path delay. This could explain browsing latency, but not the checkout connection refusal.
